# HLS.js

`hls.light.min.js` is the unmodified light build of HLS.js 1.7.3 (Apache-2.0).
It is served locally; the player makes no CDN requests.

- Upstream: https://github.com/video-dev/hls.js/tree/v1.7.3
- Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/hls.js/-/hls.js-1.7.3.tgz
- Extracted file: `package/dist/hls.light.min.js`
- SHA-256: `0251332c00a216a35d7d6919044d60da82b78beb3bd50ac6c662ae74a2f5474b`
- License: `hls-LICENSE.txt`

The package tarball's SHA-512 integrity was checked against npm metadata before
extraction. Update this file, the script version in index.html, and browser
playback checks together when updating the library.

The upstream notice is in hls-LICENSE.txt; the complete Apache license text is in Apache-2.0.txt.
